anc-001.title: Monsoon Waste Segregation & Gutter Clearing Protocol
anc-001.content: Due to heavy rainfall alerts across Vashi and Koperkhairane, residents are advised to keep dry recyclable waste enclosed in waterproof bags. Morning clearance runs will commence 30 minutes earlier.

anc-002.title: Monthly Electronic & Hazardous Waste Drive this Saturday
anc-002.content: Central Municipal MRF Facility at Sector 18 will host a dedicated collection drive for batteries, discarded electronics, and CFL lamps this Saturday from 09:00 AM to 04:00 PM.

anc-003.title: Electric Tipper Van Fleet Expanded for Narrow Alleyways
anc-003.content: Four new zero-emission Electric Waste Carts have been deployed to Sector 4 and Sector 9 for daily morning wet waste pickup in pedestrianized corridors.
